description: Defines classes EffectDescriptor and EffectDescriptorCollection for managing audio effect descriptors within Android's audio policy framework.

classes.name: EffectDescriptor
classes.description: Represents an audio effect descriptor with properties like ID, session, IO handle, and effect description.

classes.name: EffectDescriptorCollection
classes.description: Manages a collection of EffectDescriptor objects, allowing registration, unregistration, querying, and moving effects.

methods.name: EffectDescriptor::dump
methods.description: Outputs the details of the EffectDescriptor to a String8 buffer.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::registerEffect
methods.description: Registers a new effect descriptor with specified parameters.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::unregisterEffect
methods.description: Removes an effect descriptor by ID.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::getEffect
methods.description: Retrieves an effect descriptor by ID.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::getEffectsForIo
methods.description: Returns effects associated with a specific IO handle.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::setEffectEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables an effect by ID.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::isEffectEnabled
methods.description: Checks if an effect is enabled by ID.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::getMaxEffectsCpuLoad
methods.description: Returns the maximum CPU load used by effects.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::getMaxEffectsMemory
methods.description: Returns the maximum memory used by effects.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::isNonOffloadableEffectEnabled
methods.description: Checks if any non-offloadable effects are enabled.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::moveEffects
methods.description: Moves effects between sessions or IO handles.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::getIoForSession
methods.description: Retrieves the IO handle associated with a session.

methods.name: EffectDescriptorCollection::setEffectEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of a specific effect descriptor.
